name: JoAi: Delete Automation

description.en: Permanently delete a lifecycle automation that has no active enrollments. Use with care — this cannot be undone.
description.de: Löscht eine Lifecycle-Automation ohne aktive Enrollments dauerhaft. Vorsicht — nicht rückgängig zu machen.
description.fr: Supprime définitivement une automatisation sans enrollments actifs. À utiliser avec précaution — irréversible.
description.es: Elimina permanentemente una automatización sin enrollments activos. Úsalo con cuidado: no se puede deshacer.
description.it: Elimina definitivamente un'automazione senza enrollment attivi. Da usare con cautela — non reversibile.
description.ro: Șterge definitiv o automatizare fără enrollment-uri active. Folosește cu atenție — nu poate fi anulată.

bot: Use when the user wants to remove an automation. Blocked while enrollments are active — disable or wait first. Prefer list_automations to find the ID.

inputs.name: Automation ID
inputs.bot: Automation hashid. List automations first if the user only has a name.

error.fr: Échec de la suppression de l'automatisation : {{MESSAGE}}
error.es: No se pudo eliminar la automatización: {{MESSAGE}}
